title: Nonsymmetric monoid axiom with arbitrary auxiliary objects
statement: Let $\mathcal M$ be a cocomplete model category, with model-category and fixed universe $\mathcal U$ conventions as in [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction] and colimits as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give $\mathcal M$ a monoidal structure [def-sfb-monoidal-category], not assumed symmetric. Write $0$ for its initial object. Let $G$ consist of all finite nonempty left-associated pushout products $a_1\mathbin\square\cdots\mathbin\square a_n$, where every factor is a trivial cofibration or the initial map $0\to X$ of an arbitrary object, and at least one factor is a trivial cofibration. Here the pushout product of $a:A\to B$ and $b:C\to D$ is $(B\odot C)\amalg_{A\odot C}(A\odot D)\to B\odot D$. The nonsymmetric monoid axiom means that the smallest class containing $G$ and closed under pushouts, $\mathcal U$-small continuous transfinite compositions and arrow retracts consists of weak equivalences. Equivalently, there is such a closed class $K$ with $G\subseteq K\subseteq W$. Continuous means that at each nonzero limit ordinal the stage is the colimit of preceding stages; an arrow retract is a retract in the arrow category.
